product_wide_rationale: Governs which facts Concord may store about a session and its worktree, so it binds every Domain that resolves a tree rather than owning a runtime Domain.
summary: A session's worktree is the directory the host reports for it, and Concord stores no copy. The bootstrap launch record and session_worktree_targets are dropped with the retarget, release, and takeover operations, because each was a stored copy of a host fact with no reader outside its own maintenance, and each drifted. work_start replays to convergence on its derived key, so no partial outcome exists. Transient exclusion is resource_busy, coupled to retry_same_request. Amends CD-0096 at Context, D1, D3 Take over, D5, and D6; CD-0088 D4 at the launch record; CD-0098 at the failure contract.
title: A session's worktree is its actual directory, and Concord stores no session binding
